content.text:
All done. Here is a summary of what was implemented:

**Files created/modified (commit `0accfe2`):**

1. `components/TOHaejungUpload.tsx` (new) — File input + upload button component; validates `.xlsx` extension, shows confirmation dialog before replacing data, displays success/error status messages.

2. `app/admin/page.tsx` (replaced) — Converted from a server component to a `'use client'` tabbed page. Two tabs: "제출 현황" (renders existing `AdminDashboard`) and "TO 배정 관리" (upload + editable table). Includes `handleSave` wired to `PATCH /api/to-haejung/[id]` and `loadRows` passed to `TOHaejungUpload.onSuccess`. Outermost div carries `max-w-7xl mx-auto px-4 sm:px-6 lg:px-8 py-8` wrapper.

3. `app/page.tsx` (replaced) — Was `redirect('/dean')`, now a read-only TO 배정 현황 page that fetches from `GET /api/to-haejung` and renders `<TOHaejungTable rows={rows} />` (no `editable` prop).

4. `app/layout.tsx` (updated) — `<main>` changed to `className="w-full"` (width constraint moved to individual pages). Added "TO 배정 현황" nav link pointing to `/` before the "학장 입력" link.

5. `app/dean/page.tsx` (updated) — Outermost `<div>` gained `className="max-w-3xl mx-auto px-4 sm:px-6 lg:px-8 py-8"` wrapper.

**Type check result:** Zero errors in source files. The 34 pre-existing errors in `__tests__/` (`.toBeInTheDocument` type augmentation gap and a `Buffer`/`BlobPart` incompatibility) were present before these changes.
